name: Gangs Trials
description: First-party worldgen gate for The Gangs Modpack: restricts configured structures (by default minecraft:trial_chambers) to an allowlist of dimensions (by default multiworld:rsw). Also fixes Tricky Trials Backport trial spawner configs, spawner light rules, wind charge self-launch, breeze infighting, trial spawner hardness and the missing ominous item spawner renderer.
